methodology: Individual sense review by the coding assistant (model-assisted semantic curation), not human or native-speaker review. Each assignment was selected by inspecting an exact English dictionary translation heading, part of speech, and competing senses. Categories use the existing project taxonomy. No headword-wide or automatic keyword-based category assignment is applied. Dictionary translations are unchanged; no additional translation or CEFR label is inferred. Parent sense topics are not used as evidence for these assignments because some source translation tables are nested under unrelated parent glosses.
